export function runDungeonPass(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState, chests: Array<{ x: number; y: number; items: Array<{ id: number; stack: number } | null> }>): void {
  const { w, h } = st;
  // ---- 1456 入口位置预计算(DungeonCrawler.cs L280-326):锚点 ±300 内拒绝采样地表点
  // (从 y=10 下扫到首个"有内容"格:实心/液体/墙),校验无云块(±15 方框 + 上方 50 带)
  // 与头顶余量(ny-40-RoughHeight40>0);成功则锚点迁移到入口旁(±25),爬升改为
  // 沿直线分段走向入口(Precalculated),否则回退 legacy 盲爬。根治:盲爬探测点落在
  // 高坡时楼梯被迫越坡堆积、后一次外壳埋掉前一次挖空 → 实心砖瘤封死下行通道 ----
  let entPos: [number, number] | null = null;
  {
    const CLOUD = new Set<number>(
      ['v_189_cloud_block', 'v_196_rain_cloud_block', 'v_460_snow_cloud_block']
        .map((k) => TILE_BY_KEY[k])
        .filter((v): v is number => v !== undefined),
    );
    let found = false, nx = 0, ny = 0;
    for (let t = 0; t < 3000 && !found; t++) {
      nx = gs.dungeonLocation - 300 + rng.int(0, 599);
      if (nx <= gs.beachDistance || nx >= w - gs.beachDistance) continue;
      ny = 10;
      while (ny < st.h - 2) {
        const i = st.idx(nx, ny);
        if (st.flags[i] || st.liquid[i] > 0 || st.wall[i] > 0) break;
        ny++;
      }
      let cloud = false;
      for (let dx = -15; dx <= 15 && !cloud; dx++) {
        for (let dy = -15; dy <= 15; dy++) {
          if (st.inBounds(nx + dx, ny + dy) && CLOUD.has(st.type[st.idx(nx + dx, ny + dy)])) { cloud = true; break; }
        }
      }
      for (let dx = -50; dx < 50 && !cloud; dx++) {
        for (let y = Math.max(50, ny - 50); y < ny; y++) {
          if (st.inBounds(nx + dx, y) && CLOUD.has(st.type[st.idx(nx + dx, y)])) { cloud = true; break; }
        }
      }
      if (cloud || ny - 80 <= 0) continue;
      found = true;
    }
    if (found) {
      gs.dungeonLocation = nx + 25 - rng.int(0, 49);
      entPos = [nx, ny];
    }
  }
  const x0 = gs.dungeonLocation;
  if (x0 < 30 || x0 > w - 30) return;
  // 原版主题在 **Dunes pass 头**已掷（SetupDungeonGenVarVariables，cs:11542）；
  // 此处只消费 gs.dungeonTheme（-1=非原版管线直调时回退自掷）
  const theme = gs.dungeonTheme >= 0 ? gs.dungeonTheme : rng.int(0, 2);
  const brick = theme === 0 ? BLUE : theme === 1 ? GREEN : PINK;
  const wallId = brick === BLUE ? 7 : brick === GREEN ? 8 : 9;
  // 深度:找实心(L6565)
  let y0 = Math.floor((gs.worldSurface + gs.rockLevel) / 2) + rng.int(-200, 199);
  let solid = false;
  for (let d = 0; d < 10; d++) if (st.flags[st.idx(x0, y0 + d)]) { solid = true; break; }
  if (!solid) {
    const cap = Math.floor((gs.worldSurface + gs.rockLevel) / 2) + 200;
    while (y0 < cap && !st.flags[st.idx(x0, y0 + 10)]) y0++;
  }
  y0 = Math.max(gs.worldSurface + 10, Math.min(h - 220, y0));
  const dc = new DungeonCtx(brick, wallId, x0, y0);
  // 原版 L18045-18048:入口塔尺寸强度(DungeonEnt 与竖井出口探测共用)
  dc.dxS1 = rng.int(25, 29); dc.dyS1 = rng.int(20, 24);
  dc.dxS2 = rng.int(35, 49); dc.dyS2 = rng.int(10, 14);
  // ---- 主链随机游走(L18053)----
  let budget = w / 60 + rng.int(0, Math.max(1, Math.floor(w / 180)));
  let dx = x0, dy = y0;
  dungeonRoom(st, rng, gs, dc, dx, dy);
  let step5 = 5;
  while (budget > 0) {
    dc.updateBBox(dx, dy);
    budget--;
    step5--;
    if (step5 === 0 && rng.next() * 3 < 1) {
      step5 = 5;
      if (rng.next() < 0.5) {
        // 分支:保存位置→走廊(可能两条)+房→恢复
        const sx = dx, sy = dy;
        [dx, dy] = dungeonHalls(st, rng, gs, dc, dx, dy, false);
        if (rng.next() < 0.5) [dx, dy] = dungeonHalls(st, rng, gs, dc, dx, dy, false);
        dungeonRoom(st, rng, gs, dc, dx, dy);
        dx = sx; dy = sy;
      } else {
        dungeonRoom(st, rng, gs, dc, dx, dy);
      }
    } else {
      [dx, dy] = dungeonHalls(st, rng, gs, dc, dx, dy, false);
    }
  }
  dungeonRoom(st, rng, gs, dc, dx, dy);
  // ---- 爬升到地表(1456 语义,DungeonCrawler.cs L400-449):上限 100;num8 到 0 后
  // 每轮 1/5 概率 halls(forceX)+room 分支(原版 num8 保持在 0) ----
  let best = dc.rooms[0];
  for (const r of dc.rooms) if (r.t < best.t) best = r;
  dc.entranceX = best.cx;
  dx = best.cx; dy = best.cy;
  if (entPos) {
    // 预计算模式:沿直线分段走向入口,每段 10-29 步,剩余距离耗尽即达(确定性终止)
    let remaining = Math.hypot(entPos[0] - dx, entPos[1] - dy);
    let delay = 5, guard = 0;
    while (remaining > 0 && guard++ < 100) {
      if (delay > 0) delay--;
      if (delay === 0 && rng.next() < 0.2 && dy > gs.worldSurface + 100) {
        delay = 10;
        const sx = dx, sy = dy;
        [dx, dy] = dungeonHalls(st, rng, gs, dc, dx, dy, true);
        dungeonRoom(st, rng, gs, dc, dx, dy);
        dx = sx; dy = sy;
      }
      let steps = rng.int(10, 29);
      if (steps > remaining) steps = Math.max(1, Math.floor(remaining));
      const d = Math.hypot(entPos[0] - dx, entPos[1] - dy) || 1;
      const res = dungeonStairs(st, rng, gs, dc, dx, dy, {
        vx: (entPos[0] - dx) / d, vy: (entPos[1] - dy) / d, steps,
      });
      dx = res[0]; dy = res[1];
      remaining -= steps;
    }
    dx = entPos[0]; dy = entPos[1];
    dungeonEnt(st, rng, gs, dc, dx, dy);
    gs.dungeonY = entPos[1];   // 入口地表 Y（刷怪门槛 CheckToSpawnDungeonEnemies）
  } else {
    // legacy 盲爬(1405 结构 + 1456 的 100 上限):外壳探测到开放天空即停
    let reached = false;
    let delay = 5, guard = 0;
    while (!reached && guard++ < 100) {
      if (delay > 0) delay--;
      if (delay === 0 && rng.next() < 0.2 && dy > gs.worldSurface + 100) {
        delay = 10;
        const sx = dx, sy = dy;
        [dx, dy] = dungeonHalls(st, rng, gs, dc, dx, dy, true);
        dungeonRoom(st, rng, gs, dc, dx, dy);
        dx = sx; dy = sy;
      }
      const res = dungeonStairs(st, rng, gs, dc, dx, dy);
      dx = res[0]; dy = res[1];
      reached = res[2];
    }
    // 兜底:楼梯没到地表则从当前位置直挖竖井到地表(垂直,保证衔接)
    if (dy > gs.worldSurface - 5) {
      let sx2 = dx, sy2 = dy;
      let guard2 = 0;
      while (sy2 > gs.worldSurface - 5 && guard2++ < 800) {
        for (let ax = -3; ax <= 3; ax++) {
          for (let ay = -3; ay <= 3; ay++) {
            if (!st.inBounds(sx2 + ax, sy2 + ay)) continue;
            const i = st.idx(sx2 + ax, sy2 + ay);
            st.flags[i] = 0; st.wall[i] = dc.wall;
          }
        }
        for (let ax = -4; ax <= 4; ax++) {
          for (let ay = -4; ay <= 4; ay++) {
            if (!st.inBounds(sx2 + ax, sy2 + ay)) continue;
            const i = st.idx(sx2 + ax, sy2 + ay);
            if (!dc.isDungeonWall(st, sx2 + ax, sy2 + ay)) { st.type[i] = dc.brick; st.flags[i] = 1; }
          }
        }
        sy2--;
      }
      dx = sx2; dy = sy2;
    }
    // 找楼梯出口列的真实地表,塔吸附其上
    let gY = 0;
    while (gY < st.h - 2 && !st.flags[st.idx(dx, gY)]) gY++;
    dungeonEnt(st, rng, gs, dc, dx, gY);
    gs.dungeonY = gY;          // 入口地表 Y（刷怪门槛 CheckToSpawnDungeonEnemies）
  }
  if (dc.entStand) {
    gs.dungeonEntX = dc.entStand[0];
    gs.dungeonEntY = dc.entStand[1];
  }
  // ---- 房口平台候选(cs L18137-18180,与门候选同期收集)----
  for (const room of dc.rooms) {
    for (let x = room.l; x <= room.r; x++) {
      if (st.inBounds(x, room.t - 1) && !st.flags[st.idx(x, room.t - 1)]) { dc.dPlatforms.push([x, room.t - 1]); break; }
    }
    for (let x = room.l; x <= room.r; x++) {
      if (st.inBounds(x, room.b + 1) && !st.flags[st.idx(x, room.b + 1)]) { dc.dPlatforms.push([x, room.b + 1]); break; }
    }
  }
  // ---- 尖刺(L18188)----
  placeSpikes(st, rng, gs, dc, Math.floor(w / 100));
  // ---- 门(L18311)----
  placeDoors(st, rng, dc);
  // ---- 陈设管线(L18441-19613):墙变体→房口平台→特殊宝箱→书架平台→房间金箱→
  //      灯具+开关布线→陷阱→地面家具→墙饰→旗帜 ----
  placeFurnishing(st, rng, gs, dc, chests);
}

/** DungeonHalls(L20255):走廊随机游走 */

function dungeonHalls(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState, dc: DungeonCtx, ix: number, iy: number, forceX: boolean): [number, number] {
  let radius = rng.int(4, 5);
  const baseR = radius;
  let steps = rng.int(35, 79);
  if (forceX) steps += 20;
  else if (rng.next() < 0.2) { radius *= 2; steps = Math.floor(steps / 2); }
  // 危险走廊(原版 1/5):内部填裂砖而非挖空
  const dangerous = !forceX && rng.next() < 0.2;
  // 方向
  let vx = 0, vy = 0;
  {
    const horiz = forceX || rng.next() < 0.5;
    if (horiz) {
      vx = rng.next() < 0.5 ? 1 : -1;
      if (rng.next() < 1 / 3) vy = (rng.next() < 0.5 ? 1 : -1) * 0.2;
    } else {
      radius++;
      vy = rng.next() < 0.5 ? 1 : -1;
      if (rng.next() < 2 / 3) vx = (rng.next() < 0.5 ? 1 : -1) * rng.int(10, 19) * 0.1;
    }
    // 边界强制
    if (!forceX) {
      if (ix > st.w - 200) vx = -Math.abs(vx || 1);
      if (ix < 200) vx = Math.abs(vx || 1);
      if (iy > st.h - 300) vy = -Math.abs(vy || 1);
      if (iy < gs.rockLevel + 100) vy = Math.abs(vy || 1);
      // 边界三分带强制(cs L20474-20485):走廊被推向外侧——
      // 0.5w-0.75w → +1、0.25w-0.5w → -1(原版语义,铺向外侧三分而非向中心聚集)
      if (ix > st.w / 2 && ix < st.w * 0.75) vx = Math.abs(vx || 0.5);
      if (ix > st.w * 0.25 && ix < st.w / 2) vx = -Math.abs(vx || 0.5);
    }
    if (vx === 0 && vy === 0) vx = 1;
  }
  if (vx !== 0 && vy === 0 && rng.next() * 3 < 2 && !forceX) {

function dungeonRoom(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, _gs: GenState, dc: DungeonCtx, ix: number, iy: number): void {

  for (let k = 0; k < steps; k++) {

    for (let x = Math.floor(px - outerX); x <= Math.floor(px + outerX); x++) {
      for (let y = Math.floor(py - outerY); y <= Math.floor(py + outerY); y++) {
        if (!st.inBounds(x, y)) continue;
        const i = st.idx(x, y);
        st.liquid[i] = 0;
        if (!dc.isDungeonWall(st, x, y)) { st.type[i] = dc.brick; st.flags[i] = 1; }
      }
    }
    dc.updateBBox(Math.floor(px), Math.floor(py));
    // 内缩 1 墙 + 内框挖空
    for (let x = Math.floor(px - size * 0.8); x <= Math.floor(px + size * 0.8); x++) {
      for (let y = Math.floor(py - size * 0.8); y <= Math.floor(py + size * 0.8); y++) {
        if (!st.inBounds(x, y)) continue;
        const edge = Math.abs(x - px) > size * 0.5 || Math.abs(y - py) > size * 0.5;
        const i = st.idx(x, y);
        if (edge) st.wall[i] = dc.wall;
        else {
          st.flags[i] = 0; st.wall[i] = dc.wall;
          rl = Math.min(rl, x); rr = Math.max(rr, x);
          rt = Math.min(rt, y); rb = Math.max(rb, y);
        }
      }
    }
    px += vx; py += vy;
    vx += rng.int(-10, 10) * 0.05; vy += rng.int(-10, 10) * 0.05;
    vx = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, vx)); vy = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, vy));
  }
  dc.rooms.push({ cx: Math.floor(px), cy: Math.floor(py), l: rl, r: rr, t: rt, b: rb });
  // 门候选(cs L18158-18179):房左右墙外侧列的首个空格
  if (rl > 1 && rr < st.w - 2) {
    for (let y = rt; y <= rb; y++) {
      if (st.inBounds(rl - 1, y) && !st.flags[st.idx(rl - 1, y)]) { dc.dDoors.push({ x: rl - 1, y, pos: -1 }); break; }
    }
    for (let y = rt; y <= rb; y++) {
      if (st.inBounds(rr + 1, y) && !st.flags[st.idx(rr + 1, y)]) { dc.dDoors.push({ x: rr + 1, y, pos: 1 }); break; }
    }
  }
}

      const ud = gs.undergroundDesert;
      if (ud && ((cx > ud.x0 && cx < ud.x1) || (zLo > ud.x0 && zLo < ud.x1) || (zHi > ud.x0 && zHi < ud.x1))) ok = false;
      if (zLo < gs.dungeonLocation + dungeonAvoid && zHi > gs.dungeonLocation - dungeonAvoid) ok = false;
      if (zLo < jnHi && zHi > jnLo) { jnLo++; jnHi--; ok = false; }
      if (zLo < snHi && zHi > snLo) { snLo++; snHi--; ok = false; }
    }
    gs.evilZones.push({ x0: zLo, x1: zHi });

    if (gs.crimson) {
      crimStart(st, rng, gs, cx, gs.worldSurfaceLow - 10);
      // 地表转换:猩红石/猩红草/猩红沙 + 墙 216→218、187→221;丛林泥/草清除
      convertSurface(st, rng, gs, zLo, zHi, true);
      // 祭坛 10-14 个(v_26 style 1)
      placeAltars(st, rng, gs, zLo, zHi, 1, CRIMSTONE);
    } else {
      // 腐化裂隙:主裂隙(cx, 150-300 步) + 35 分之一支裂隙(50-100 步带球)
      let cooldown = 0;
      for (let x = zLo; x < zHi; x++) {
        if (cooldown > 0) cooldown--;
        if (x !== cx && cooldown !== 0) continue;
        let sy = -1;
        for (let y = gs.worldSurfaceLow; y < gs.worldSurface - 1; y++) {
          if (st.flags[st.idx(x, y)] || st.wall[st.idx(x, y)] > 0) {
            if (x === cx) {
              cooldown = 20;
              chasmRunner(st, rng, gs, x, y, rng.int(0, 149) + 150, true);
            } else if (rng.int(0, 34) === 0) {
              cooldown = 30;
              chasmRunner(st, rng, gs, x, y, rng.int(0, 49) + 50, true);
            }
            break;
          }
        }
      }
      convertSurface(st, rng, gs, zLo, zHi, false);
      // 暗影之球周的黑檀石囊清理(原版 6416-6446)
      cleanOrbPockets(st, rng);
    }
  }
}

/** 地表转换(腐化/猩红通用):L6195-6232 / L6388-6414 */
function convertSurface(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState, zLo: number, zHi: number, crimson: boolean): void {
  // 丛林泥/草清除(地表 10-14 格深)
  for (let x = zLo; x < zHi; x++) {
    for (let y = gs.worldSurfaceLow; y < gs.worldSurface - 1; y++) {
      if (!st.flags[st.idx(x, y)]) continue;
      const depth = y + rng.int(10, 13);
      for (let y2 = y; y2 < depth; y2++) {
        const t = st.type[st.idx(x, y2)];
        if ((t === MUD || t === JUNGLE_GRASS) && x >= zLo + rng.int(0, 4) && x < zHi - rng.int(0, 4)) {
          st.type[st.idx(x, y2)] = 0;
        }
      }
      break;
    }
  }
  // 深度游走转换带
  let bandY = gs.worldSurface + 40;
  for (let x = zLo; x < zHi; x++) {
    bandY += rng.int(-2, 2);
    if (bandY < gs.worldSurface + 30) bandY = gs.worldSurface + 30;
    if (bandY > gs.worldSurface + 50) bandY = gs.worldSurface + 50;
    let first = true;
    for (let y = gs.worldSurfaceLow; y < bandY; y++) {
      const i = st.idx(x, y);
      if (!st.flags[i]) continue;
      const t = st.type[i];
      const inCore = x >= zLo + rng.int(0, 4) && x <= zHi - rng.int(0, 4);
      if (t === T.SAND && inCore) st.type[i] = crimson ? CRIMSAND : EBONSAND;
      if (t === T.DIRT && y < gs.worldSurface - 1 && first) {
        // 暴露泥土 → 邪恶草(原版 SpreadGrass(0→23/199))
        st.type[i] = crimson ? CRIMSON_GRASS : CORRUPT_GRASS;
      }
      first = false;
      if (st.wall[i] === 216) st.wall[i] = crimson ? 218 : 217;
      else if (st.wall[i] === 187) st.wall[i] = crimson ? 221 : 220;
      if (t === T.STONE) {
        if (inCore) st.type[i] = crimson ? CRIMSTONE : EBONSTONE;
      } else if (t === T.GRASS) st.type[i] = crimson ? CRIMSON_GRASS : CORRUPT_GRASS;
      else if (t === JUNGLE_GRASS) st.type[i] = crimson ? CRIMSON_JUNGLE_GRASS : CORRUPT_JUNGLE_GRASS; // 1456 cs:14219/14540 60→662/661（1.4.5 新增邪恶丛林草）
      else if (t === SNOW_BRICK) st.type[i] = crimson ? CRIMSON_ICE : CORRUPT_ICE; // 原版 161→163/200(cs L6397)
      else if (t === SANDSTONE) st.type[i] = crimson ? CRIMSON_SANDSTONE : CORRUPT_SANDSTONE; // 396→401/400（无 inCore 门，cs:14223/14544）
      else if (t === HARDSAND) st.type[i] = crimson ? CRIMSON_HARDSAND : CORRUPT_HARDSAND;
    }
  }
}

/** 恶魔祭坛:10-14 个,落在邪恶石地表上(Place3x2) */
function placeAltars(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState, zLo: number, zHi: number, style: number, stoneType: number): void {
  const count = rng.int(10, 14);
  for (let n = 0; n < count; n++) {
    let widen = 0, tries = 0, done = false;

      tries++;

      let y = rng.int(Math.max(2, Math.floor(gs.worldSurface - widen / 2)), Math.floor(gs.worldSurface + 100 + widen) - 1);
      if (x < 2) x = 2; if (x > st.w - 3) x = st.w - 3;
      if (!st.flags[st.idx(x, y)]) {
        while (!st.flags[st.idx(x, y)] && y < st.h - 2) y++;

      } else {

      }

        place3x2(st, x, y, ALTAR, style);
        if (st.type[st.idx(x, y)] === ALTAR) done = true;
      }
      if (tries > 100) { widen++; tries = 0; }

function isTileNearby(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number, type: number, radius: number): boolean {
  for (let dx = -radius; dx <= radius; dx++) {
    for (let dy = -radius; dy <= radius; dy++) {
      if (!st.inBounds(x + dx, y + dy)) continue;
      if (st.type[st.idx(x + dx, y + dy)] === type) return true;
    }
  }
  return false;
}

/** 3×2 物件放置(锚点=中下):帧 style*54 + col*18 / row*18 */
function place3x2(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number, type: number, style: number): void {
  if (x < 5 || x > st.w - 5 || y < 5 || y > st.h - 5) return;
  for (let dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) {
    if (!st.isSolid(x + dx, y + 1)) return; // 底座须实心
  }
  for (let dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) {
    for (let dy = -1; dy <= 0; dy++) {
      if (st.flags[st.idx(x + dx, y + dy)]) return; // 区域须净空
    }
  }
  for (let dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) {
    for (let dy = -1; dy <= 0; dy++) {
      st.setTileSilent(x + dx, y + dy, type, style * 54 + (dx + 1) * 18, (dy + 1) * 18);
    }
  }
}

/** 暗影之球(AddShadowOrb L16035):2×2,猩红 style 偏移 +36 */
function addShadowOrb(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number, crimson: boolean): void {
  if (x < 10 || x > st.w - 10 || y < 10 || y > st.h - 10) return;
  for (let dx = -1; dx < 1; dx++) {
    for (let dy = -1; dy < 1; dy++) {
      if (st.flags[st.idx(x + dx, y + dy)] && st.type[st.idx(x + dx, y + dy)] === ORB) return;
    }
  }
  const fx = crimson ? 36 : 0;
  st.setTileSilent(x - 1, y - 1, ORB, fx, 0);
  st.setTileSilent(x, y - 1, ORB, 18 + fx, 0);
  st.setTileSilent(x - 1, y, ORB, fx, 18);
  st.setTileSilent(x, y, ORB, 18 + fx, 18);
}

/** CrimStart(L45443):弹坑隧道 + CrimVein 血管(5-8 条,终点=恶魔之心) */
function crimStart(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState, i: number, j: number): void {
  const entryX = i, entryY0 = Math.min(j, gs.worldSurface);
  let py = entryY0;
  while (!st.isSolid(i, py) && py < st.h - 2) py++;

  // 主通道随机走(向下椭圆隧道)
  while (true) {
    radius += rng.int(-50, 50) * 0.01;
    radius = Math.max(15, Math.min(25, radius));
    const x0 = Math.floor(px - radius / 2), x1 = Math.floor(px + radius / 2);
    const y0 = Math.floor(py - radius / 2), y1 = Math.floor(py + radius / 2);
    for (let x = x0; x < x1; x++) {
      for (let y = y0; y < y1; y++) {
        if (!st.inBounds(x, y)) continue;
        const d = Math.abs(x - px) + Math.abs(y - py);
        const ti = st.idx(x, y);
        if (y > startY) {
          if (d < radius * 0.3) {
            st.type[ti] = 0; st.flags[ti] = 0; st.wall[ti] = 83;
          } else if (d < radius * 0.8 && st.wall[ti] !== 83) {
            st.flags[ti] = 1; st.type[ti] = CRIMSTONE;
            if (d < radius * 0.6) st.wall[ti] = 83;
          }
        } else if (d < radius * 0.3 && st.flags[ti]) {
          st.type[ti] = 0; st.flags[ti] = 0; st.wall[ti] = 83;
        }
      }
    }
    // X 回中(cs L45494-45503):漂离入口 ±50 后设反向偏置,未漂时正常随机走
    if (px > entryX + 50) recenter = -100;
    if (px < entryX - 50) recenter = 100;
    if (recenter < 0) vx -= rng.int(20, 50) * 0.01;
    else if (recenter > 0) vx += rng.int(20, 50) * 0.01;
    else vx += rng.int(-50, 50) * 0.01;
    vy += rng.int(-50, 50) * 0.01;
    vy = Math.max(0.25, Math.min(2, vy));
    vx = Math.max(-2, Math.min(2, vx));
    px += vx; py += vy;
    if (py > gs.worldSurface + 100) break;
    if (py > st.h - 10 || px < 5 || px > st.w - 5) break;
  }
  // ---- 隧道终点囊群(cs L45551-45585):50 个半径 40-54 球,核心 0.25R 清空、壳 0.4R 猩红石 ----

function crimVein(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, sx: number, sy: number, ivx: number, ivy: number): [number, number] {

    const y0 = Math.floor(py - radius / 2), y1 = Math.floor(py + radius / 2);
    for (let x = x0; x < x1; x++) {
      for (let y = y0; y < y1; y++) {

  const out = new Set<number>();
  for (const d of TILE_DEFS) {

function spreadGrassOnce(st: TileStore, i: number, j: number, dirt: number, grass: number): void {
  if (i < 10 || i >= st.w - 10 || j < 10 || j >= st.h - 10) return;   // InWorld(i,j,10)
  const ti = st.idx(i, j);
  if (!st.flags[ti] || st.type[ti] !== dirt) return;
  let enclosed = true;
  for (let k = Math.max(0, i - 1); k < Math.min(st.w, i + 2); k++) {
    for (let l = Math.max(0, j - 1); l < Math.min(st.h, j + 2); l++) {

      if (!st.flags[ni] || !TILE_DEFS[st.type[ni]]?.solid) enclosed = false;
      if (st.liquidType[ni] === 2 && st.liquid[ni] > 0) { enclosed = true; break; }  // lava
    }
  }
  if (enclosed) return;
  // CanBeClearedDuringGeneration：与 TileRunner NOT_CLEAR 同源（dirt 族可清）
  const d = TILE_DEFS[st.type[ti]];
  if (d?.vanilla?.sheet != null && NOT_CLEARABLE.has(d.vanilla.sheet)) return;
  st.type[ti] = grass;
}

// num6(含冲突重掷)/num5/左右枝 k、tuft 双门、基座、树冠骰全部照 JS 顺序。
void GrowAshTree(int tx, int ty)
{
    // 越过树苗（灰烬区无树苗 → 立即停）
    int num = ty;
    while (num < H && act[num * W + tx] != 0 && typ[num * W + tx] == 590) num++;   // 树苗 590
    if (num >= H || num < 1) return;
    // 基座上一格三列无液体
    if (liq[(num - 1) * W + tx - 1] != 0 || liq[(num - 1) * W + tx] != 0 || liq[(num - 1) * W + tx + 1] != 0) return;
    int gi = num * W + tx;
    if (act[gi] == 0) return;                                  // 基座须整砖（half/slope 此阶段无）
    if (!TREE_WALLS.Contains(wal[(num - 1) * W + tx])) return; // 墙白名单
    if (typ[gi] != 633) return;                                // AshTreeGroundTest：仅灰烬草
    bool sideFit(int dx) => tx + dx >= 0 && tx + dx < W && act[num * W + tx + dx] != 0 && typ[num * W + tx + dx] == 633;
    if (!sideFit(-1) && !sideFit(1)) return;
    int height = (int)r.Next(7, 13);
    int num4 = height + 4;                                     // TreeTopPaddingNeeded = 4
    if (tx - 2 < 0 || tx + 2 >= W || num - num4 < 0) return;
    for (int ex = tx - 2; ex <= tx + 2; ex++)
        for (int ey = num - num4; ey <= num - 1; ey++)
        {

  /** C# InternalSample（:67-86）1:1。inext 为 uint 语义（0..55，无溢出面）*/
  private internalSample(): number {
    let num = this.inext + 1;
    if (num > 55) num = 1;
    let num2 = num + 21;
    if (num2 > 55) num2 -= 55;
    let num3 = this.seedArray[num] - this.seedArray[num2];
    if (num3 === 2147483647) num3--;
    num3 = num3 + ((num3 >> 31) & 0x7fffffff); // >>31 算术移位，JS/C# 一致
    this.seedArray[num] = num3;
    this.inext = num;
    return num3;
  }

  /** C# GetSampleForLargeRange（:96-104）。注意两次 InternalSample 的求值顺序 */
  private getSampleForLargeRange(): number {
    let num = this.internalSample();
    if (this.internalSample() % 2 === 0) num = -num;
    return (num + 2147483646) / 4294967293;
  }

  /** C# Next()（:106-108）：裸 int32 */
  next(): number {
    return this.internalSample();
  }

  /** C# Next(minValue, maxValue)（:115-133）：[min, max)。maxValue 负值时 C# 抛异常，
   *  本移植不抛（生成期契约保证入参合法）。*/
  nextIntRange(minValue: number, maxValue: number): number {
    const num = maxValue - minValue; // C# long 减法，≤2^32，JS 精确
    if (num <= 2147483647) {
      return (Math.trunc(this.sample() * num) + minValue) | 0;
    }
    return (Math.trunc(this.getSampleForLargeRange() * num) + minValue) | 0;
  }

  /** C# Next(maxValue)（:121-127）：[0, max) */
  nextInt(maxValue: number): number {
    return Math.trunc(this.sample() * maxValue);

  nextDouble(): number {
    return this.sample();

  peek(): number {

    if (num > 55) num = 1;
    let num2 = num + 21;
    if (num2 > 55) num2 -= 55;

using System;

namespace Terraria.Utilities;

[Serializable]
public class UnifiedRandom
{
	private const int MBIG = int.MaxValue;

	private const int MSEED = 161803398;

	private const int MZ = 0;

	private uint inext;

	private int[] SeedArray = new int[56];

	public UnifiedRandom()
		: this(Environment.TickCount)
	{
	}

	public UnifiedRandom(int Seed)
	{
		SetSeed(Seed);
	}

	public void SetSeed(int Seed)
	{

32	/** TileID.Sets.Boulders（TileID.cs:195）——Place3x2 type=26 的底座巨石门 */
33	const BOULDERS = new Set<number>([
34	  'v_138_boulder', 'v_484_rolling_cactus', 'v_664_bouncy_boulder', 'v_665_life_crystal_boulder',
35	  'v_711_rainbow_boulder', 'v_712_poo_boulder', 'v_713_lava_boulder', 'v_714_spider_boulder',
36	  'v_715_ghoulder', 'v_716_friendly_boulder',
37	].map((k) => TILE_BY_KEY[k]).filter((v): v is number => v !== undefined));
38	/** CanEvilReplace(WorldGen.cs:76182-76197):地牢砖族(tileDungeon 41/43/44/677-679,Main.cs:7941-7946)
39	 *  /裂砖族(CrackedBricks 481-483)/地牢墙(wallDungeon 7-9/94-99,Main.cs:10507-10515)不可替换 */
40	const TILE_DUNGEON = new Set([41, 43, 44, 677, 678, 679]);
41	const WALL_DUNGEON = new Set([7, 8, 9, 94, 95, 96, 97, 98, 99]);
42	function canEvilReplace(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number): boolean {
43	  const i = st.idx(x, y);
44	  if (st.flags[i]) {
45	    const sheet = TILE_DEFS[st.type[i]]?.vanilla?.sheet ?? -1;
46	    if (TILE_DUNGEON.has(sheet) || (sheet >= 481 && sheet <= 483)) return false;  // tileDungeon ∪ CrackedBricks
47	  }
48	  return !WALL_DUNGEON.has(st.wall[i]);
49	}
50	const ORB = TILE_BY_KEY['v_31_orb_heart']!;
51	const SANDSTONE = TILE_BY_KEY['sandstone']!;
52	const HARDSAND = TILE_BY_KEY['hardened_sand']!;
53	const DEMONITE = TILE_BY_KEY['ore_demonite']!;   // tile 22（侧裂隙末端魔矿脉 + 挖空保护 :76191）
54	const CRIMTANE = TILE_BY_KEY['ore_crimtane']!;  // tile 204 猩红矿（挖空保护 :76191）
55	
56	const COLBUF: string[] = [];
57	export function __crDump(): string { return COLBUF.join('\n'); }

59	export function runCorruptionPass(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState): void {
60	  const { w, h } = st;
61	  COLBUF.push(`crStartJS p=${rng.vanilla.peek()}`);
62	  setWorldSurfaceRef(() => gs.worldSurface);   // SpreadGrass 的 dirt==0 地表门禁
63	  // 丛林/雪原横向范围(±10 回避, cs:13936-13952)
64	  let jMin = w, jMax = 0, sMin = w, sMax = 0;
65	  for (let x = 0; x < w; x++) {
66	    for (let y = 0; y < gs.worldSurface; y++) {
67	      if (!st.flags[st.idx(x, y)]) continue;
68	      const t = st.type[st.idx(x, y)];
69	      if (t === JUNGLE_GRASS) { jMin = Math.min(jMin, x); jMax = Math.max(jMax, x); }
70	      else if (t === SNOW || t === ICE) { sMin = Math.min(sMin, x); sMax = Math.max(sMax, x); }
71	    }
72	  }
73	  const avoid = 10;
74	  const jLo = jMin - avoid, jHi = jMax + avoid, sLo = sMin - avoid, sHi = sMax + avoid;
75	  const beachAvoid = 380;   // evilBiomeBeachAvoidance = beachSandRandomCenter(320)+60
76	  const dungeonAvoid = 100;
77	  const midFixer = 50;      // evilBiomeAvoidanceMidFixer
78	  // ★裸 double：4200×0.00045 = 1.89 → 两组！（曾 floor 成 1 → 整片邪恶群系少一半）
79	  const groupCount = w * 0.00045;
80	  const hearts: Array<[number, number]> = [];
81	  for (let g = 0; g < groupCount; g++) {
82	    let snowLo = sLo, snowHi = sHi, jungLo = jLo, jungHi = jHi;
83	    let cx = 0, zLo = 0, zHi = 0;
84	    let ok = false;
85	    let att = 0;
86	    // 拒绝采样（cs:13979-14009）：地牢侧钳制 → 地牢 ±100 → 中央 ±200 → 沙漠 → 雪原 → 丛林
87	    while (!ok) {
88	      att++;
89	      ok = true;
90	      cx = rng.int(500, w - 501);                              // Next(num8=500, w-500)(cs:13976/14012);曾误用 380 避滩值
91	      zLo = cx - rng.int(0, 199) - 100;                        // Next(200)
92	      zHi = cx + rng.int(0, 199) + 100;
93	      if (zLo < beachAvoid) zLo = beachAvoid;
94	      if (zHi > w - beachAvoid) zHi = w - beachAvoid;
95	      if (cx < zLo + midFixer) cx = zLo + midFixer;
96	      if (cx > zHi - midFixer) cx = zHi - midFixer;
97	      if (gs.dungeonSide < 0 && zLo < 400) zLo = 400;          // dungeonSide<=Left
98	      else if (gs.dungeonSide > 0 && zLo > w - 400) zLo = w - 400;
99	      if (zLo < gs.dungeonLocation + dungeonAvoid && zHi > gs.dungeonLocation - dungeonAvoid) ok = false;
100	      const mid = w / 2;
101	      if (Math.abs(cx - mid) < 200 || Math.abs(zLo - mid) < 200 || Math.abs(zHi - mid) < 200) ok = false;
102	      const ud = gs.undergroundDesert;
103	      if (ud && ((cx > ud.x0 && cx < ud.x1) || (zLo > ud.x0 && zLo < ud.x1) || (zHi > ud.x0 && zHi < ud.x1))) ok = false;
104	      if (zLo < snowHi && zHi > snowLo) { snowLo++; snowHi--; ok = false; }   // cs:14006-14010（先雪后林）
105	      if (zLo < jungHi && zHi > jungLo) { jungLo++; jungHi--; ok = false; }
106	    }
107	    COLBUF.push(`g=${g} att=${att} cx=${cx} zLo=${zLo} zHi=${zHi} p=${rng.vanilla.peek()}`);
108	    gs.evilZones.push({ x0: zLo, x1: zHi });
109	
110	    if (gs.crimson) {
111	      crimStart(st, rng, gs, cx, gs.worldSurfaceLow - 10, hearts);
112	      // 丛林草→猩红丛林草（cs:14110-14122：仅 type 60→662；曾误把泥也清成 0）
113	      for (let x = zLo; x < zHi; x++) {
114	        for (let y = gs.worldSurfaceLow; y < gs.worldSurface - 1; y++) {
115	          if (!st.flags[st.idx(x, y)]) continue;
116	          const depth = y + rng.int(10, 13);                  // Next(10,14)
117	          for (let y2 = y; y2 < depth; y2++) {
118	            if (st.flags[st.idx(x, y2)] && st.type[st.idx(x, y2)] === JUNGLE_GRASS
119	              && x >= zLo + rng.int(0, 4) && x < zHi - rng.int(0, 4)) {
120	              st.type[st.idx(x, y2)] = CRIMSON_JUNGLE_GRASS;
121	            }
122	          }
123	          break;
124	        }
125	      }
126	      convertSurface(st, rng, gs, zLo, zHi, true);
127	      placeAltars(st, rng, gs, zLo, zHi, 1, CRIMSTONE);
128	    } else {
129	      // 腐化裂隙（cs:14368-14390）+ 丛林草→腐化丛林草（cs:14392-14404）
130	      let cooldown = 0;
131	      for (let x = zLo; x < zHi; x++) {
132	        if (cooldown > 0) cooldown--;
133	        if (x === cx || cooldown === 0) {
134	          let sy = -1;
135	          for (let y = gs.worldSurfaceLow; y < gs.worldSurface - 1; y++) {
136	            if (st.flags[st.idx(x, y)] || st.wall[st.idx(x, y)] > 0) {
137	              sy = y;
138	              if (x >= 410 && x <= 416) COLBUF.push(`scanJS x=${x} y=${y} wall=${st.wall[st.idx(x, y)]} act=${st.flags[st.idx(x, y)]} pre=${rng.vanilla.peek()}`);
139	              if (x === cx) {
140	                cooldown = 20;
141	                if (x === 414) COLBUF.push(`trig414JS main y=${y} p=${rng.vanilla.peek()}`);
142	                chasmRunner(st, rng, gs, x, y, rng.int(0, 149) + 150, true);
143	                if (x === 414) COLBUF.push(`trig414JS mainDone p=${rng.vanilla.peek()}`);
144	              } else if (rng.int(0, 34) === 0) {
145	                cooldown = 30;
146	                if (x === 414) COLBUF.push(`trig414JS side roll p=${rng.vanilla.peek()}`);
147	                chasmRunner(st, rng, gs, x, y, rng.int(0, 49) + 50, true);
148	                if (x === 414) COLBUF.push(`trig414JS sideDone p=${rng.vanilla.peek()}`);
149	              }
150	              break;
151	            }
152	          }
153	          void sy;
154	        }
155	        COLBUF.push(`x=${x} p=${rng.vanilla.peek()}`);
156	        for (let y = gs.worldSurfaceLow; y < gs.worldSurface - 1; y++) {
157	          if (!st.flags[st.idx(x, y)]) continue;
158	          const depth = y + rng.int(10, 13);
159	          for (let y2 = y; y2 < depth; y2++) {
160	            if (st.flags[st.idx(x, y2)] && st.type[st.idx(x, y2)] === JUNGLE_GRASS
161	              && x >= zLo + rng.int(0, 4) && x < zHi - rng.int(0, 4)) {
162	              st.type[st.idx(x, y2)] = CORRUPT_JUNGLE_GRASS;  // 60→661
163	            }
164	          }
165	          break;
166	        }
167	      }
168	      COLBUF.push(`chasmDone p=${rng.vanilla.peek()}`);
169	      convertSurface(st, rng, gs, zLo, zHi, false);
170	      COLBUF.push(`bandDone p=${rng.vanilla.peek()}`);
171	      // 暗影球周黑檀石囊（cs:14546-14581，★仅本组区间；第二条件仅清 active 保 type 幽灵）
172	      cleanOrbPockets(st, rng, zLo, zHi);
173	    }
174	  }
175	  // CrimPlaceHearts（cs:14331）：全组结束后一次性（曾逐组内联 → 流序错位）
176	  if (gs.crimson) crimPlaceHearts(st, rng, hearts);
177	  if (typeof process !== 'undefined' && process.env.CRDBG) {
178	    import('node:fs').then(m => m.writeFileSync('/tmp/js-cr.txt', COLBUF.join('\n'))).catch(() => {});
179	  }
180	}

182	/** 地表转换带（cs:14131-14199 猩红 / cs:14406-14484 腐化）1:1。
183	 *  每格两道 Next(2) 边缘抖动门（内圈免骰）；53/1 的 ±Next(5) 门按类型各自独掷；
184	 *  首个活性格 SpreadGrass：0→199/23（递归）与 59→662/661（递归）双分支。 */
185	function convertSurface(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState, zLo: number, zHi: number, crimson: boolean): void {
186	  let bandY = gs.worldSurface + 40;
187	  for (let x = zLo; x < zHi; x++) {
188	    bandY += rng.int(-2, 2);                                    // Next(-2,3)
189	    if (bandY < gs.worldSurface + 30) bandY = gs.worldSurface + 30;
190	    if (bandY > gs.worldSurface + 50) bandY = gs.worldSurface + 50;
191	    let first = false;
192	    const bandStart = gs.worldSurfaceLow;                       // (int)num
193	    for (let y = bandStart; y < bandY; y++) {
194	      // 边缘抖动门（cs:14145-14147）：x/y 内圈免骰，外圈 Next(2)!=0 才过
195	      if (!((x > zLo + 1 && x < zHi - 2) || rng.int(0, 1) !== 0)) continue;
196	      if (!((y > bandStart + 1 && y < bandY - 2) || rng.int(0, 1) !== 0)) continue;
197	      const i = st.idx(x, y);
198	      if (!st.flags[i]) continue;
199	      if (st.type[i] === T.SAND && x >= zLo + rng.int(0, 4) && x <= zHi - rng.int(0, 4)) {
200	        st.type[i] = crimson ? CRIMSAND : EBONSAND;             // 53→234/112
201	      }
202	      if (y < gs.worldSurface - 1 && !first) {
203	        if (st.type[i] === T.DIRT) {
204	          grassSpreadState.n = 0;
205	          spreadGrassOnce(st, x, y, 0, crimson ? CRIMSON_GRASS : CORRUPT_GRASS, true);  // SpreadGrass(0→199/23)
206	        } else if (st.type[i] === MUD) {
207	          grassSpreadState.n = 0;
208	          spreadGrassOnce(st, x, y, MUD, crimson ? CRIMSON_JUNGLE_GRASS : CORRUPT_JUNGLE_GRASS, true); // 59→662/661
209	        }
210	      }
211	      first = true;
212	      if (st.wall[i] === 216) st.wall[i] = crimson ? 218 : 217;
213	      else if (st.wall[i] === 187) st.wall[i] = crimson ? 221 : 220;
214	      if (st.type[i] === T.STONE) {
215	        if (x >= zLo + rng.int(0, 4) && x <= zHi - rng.int(0, 4)) {
216	          st.type[i] = crimson ? CRIMSTONE : EBONSTONE;         // 1→203/25
217	        }
218	      } else if (st.type[i] === T.GRASS) st.type[i] = crimson ? CRIMSON_GRASS : CORRUPT_GRASS;
219	      else if (st.type[i] === JUNGLE_GRASS) st.type[i] = crimson ? CRIMSON_JUNGLE_GRASS : CORRUPT_JUNGLE_GRASS;
220	      else if (st.type[i] === ICE) st.type[i] = crimson ? CRIMSON_ICE : CORRUPT_ICE;       // 161→200/163
221	      else if (st.type[i] === SANDSTONE) st.type[i] = crimson ? CRIMSON_SANDSTONE : CORRUPT_SANDSTONE;  // 396→401/400
222	      else if (st.type[i] === HARDSAND) st.type[i] = crimson ? CRIMSON_HARDSAND : CORRUPT_HARDSAND;      // 397→399/398
223	    }
224	  }
225	}

227	/** 恶魔祭坛（cs:14201-14239）：10-14 个。拒绝采样 x∈[zLo-widen,zHi+widen)、
228	 *  y∈[ws-widen/2, ws+100+widen)；tries>100 先 widen++ 再找面/落点（原版顺序）；
229	 *  落点门 = widen>10 || 下方活性邪恶石，且 IsTileNearby(26,3) 无邻坛。 */
230	function placeAltars(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState, zLo: number, zHi: number, style: number, stoneType: number): void {
231	  const count = rng.int(10, 14);                               // Next(10,15)
232	  for (let n = 0; n < count; n++) {
233	    let widen = 0, tries = 0, done = false;
234	    while (!done) {
235	      tries++;
236	      let x = rng.int(zLo - widen, zHi - 1 + widen);            // Next(zLo-widen, zHi+widen)
237	      let y = rng.int(Math.floor(gs.worldSurface - widen / 2), Math.floor(gs.worldSurface + 100 + widen) - 1);
238	      // oceanDepths 重掷环（cs:14252-14256）：落点入海洋带则两点全重掷
239	      while (oceanDepths(st, gs, x, y)) {
240	        x = rng.int(zLo - widen, zHi - 1 + widen);
241	        y = rng.int(Math.floor(gs.worldSurface - widen / 2), Math.floor(gs.worldSurface + 100 + widen) - 1);
242	      }
243	      if (tries > 100) { widen++; tries = 0; }                  // ★原版先 widen 后找面
244	      if (!st.flags[st.idx(x, y)]) {
245	        while (y < st.h - 1 && !st.flags[st.idx(x, y)]) y++;
246	        y--;
247	      } else {
248	        while (y > 0 && st.flags[st.idx(x, y)] && y > gs.worldSurface) y--;
249	      }
250	      if ((widen > 10 || (st.flags[st.idx(x, y + 1)] && st.type[st.idx(x, y + 1)] === stoneType))
251	        && !isTileNearby(st, x, y, ALTAR, 3)) {
252	        place3x2(st, x, y, ALTAR, style);
253	        if (st.type[st.idx(x, y)] === ALTAR) done = true;
254	      }
255	      if (widen > 100) done = true;
256	    }
257	  }
258	}
259	
260	/** oceanDepths（cs:10978-10989）：y 超过 oceanLevel 直接 false；横向上
261	 *  进沙滩带（beachDistance 内）返回 true。oceanLevel=(worldSurface+rockLayer)/2+40（cs:4393）。 */
262	function oceanDepths(st: TileStore, gs: GenState, x: number, y: number): boolean {
263	  if (y > (gs.worldSurface + gs.rockLevel) / 2 + 40) return false;
264	  return x < gs.beachDistance || x > st.w - gs.beachDistance;
265	}
266	
267	/** IsTileNearby（cs:8828）：★须 active（曾漏 → 幽灵坛误判邻坛） */
268	function isTileNearby(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number, type: number, radius: number): boolean {
269	  for (let dx = -radius; dx <= radius; dx++) {
270	    for (let dy = -radius; dy <= radius; dy++) {
271	      if (!st.inBounds(x + dx, y + dy)) continue;
272	      const i = st.idx(x + dx, y + dy);
273	      if (st.flags[i] && st.type[i] === type) return true;
274	    }
275	  }
276	  return false;
277	}

279	/** Place3x2（cs:52097）type=26 语义：界内 + 3×2 区域净空 + 三列底座实心（★active 实心，
280	 *  曾用 st.isSolid 不判 flags）+ 底座非巨石(523)。锚点=中下，帧 style*54+col*18。 */
281	function place3x2(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number, type: number, style: number): void {
282	  if (x < 5 || x > st.w - 5 || y < 5 || y > st.h - 5) return;
283	  for (let dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) {
284	    for (let dy = -1; dy <= 0; dy++) {
285	      if (st.flags[st.idx(x + dx, y + dy)]) return;             // 区域须净空
286	    }
287	  }
288	  for (let dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) {
289	    const bi = st.idx(x + dx, y + 1);
290	    if (!st.flags[bi]) return;                                  // SolidTile2 = active+tileSolid
291	    if (!TILE_DEFS[st.type[bi]]?.solid) return;
292	    if (BOULDERS.has(st.type[bi])) return;  // TileID.Sets.Boulders（TileID.cs:195：138/484/664/665/711-716）
293	  }
294	  for (let dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) {
295	    for (let dy = -1; dy <= 0; dy++) {
296	      st.setTileSilent(x + dx, y + dy, type, style * 54 + (dx + 1) * 18, (dy + 1) * 18);
297	    }
298	  }
299	}
300	
301	/** 暗影之球(AddShadowOrb L16035):2×2,猩红 style 偏移 +36 */
302	function addShadowOrb(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number, crimson: boolean): void {
303	  if (x < 10 || x > st.w - 10 || y < 10 || y > st.h - 10) return;
304	  for (let dx = -1; dx < 1; dx++) {
305	    for (let dy = -1; dy < 1; dy++) {
306	      if (st.flags[st.idx(x + dx, y + dy)] && st.type[st.idx(x + dx, y + dy)] === ORB) return;
307	    }
308	  }
309	  const fx = crimson ? 36 : 0;
310	  st.setTileSilent(x - 1, y - 1, ORB, fx, 0);
311	  st.setTileSilent(x, y - 1, ORB, 18 + fx, 0);
312	  st.setTileSilent(x - 1, y, ORB, fx, 18);
313	  st.setTileSilent(x, y, ORB, 18 + fx, 18);
314	}
315	
316	/** ChasmRunner（cs:76066-76340）1:1：竖直裂隙。挖空/双壳全带 CanEvilReplace 门；
317	 *  壳1 = 激活+type=25（非坛才写 type），壳2 = type=25+激活+墙3（y>j+Next(3,20)）。
318	 *  球只放一次；第二裂隙尾部祭坛 = 纯随机点+IsTileNearby+Place3x2 重试 ≤10000。 */
319	function chasmRunner(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState, i: number, j: number, steps: number, makeOrb: boolean): void {
320	  let sideways = false, orbPlaced = !makeOrb, altarPlaced = false;
321	  let num1 = steps + 0.0;
322	  let px = i + 0.0, py = j + 0.0;
323	  let vx = rng.int(-10, 10) * 0.1;                             // Next(-10,11)
324	  let vy = rng.int(0, 10) * 0.2 + 0.5;                         // Next(11)*0.2+0.5
325	  let radius = rng.int(0, 4) + 7;                              // Next(5)+7
326	  const num3 = 5;
327	  while (radius > 0) {
328	    if (num1 > 0) {
329	      radius += rng.int(0, 2) - rng.int(0, 2);                // Next(3) 两次
330	      if (radius < 7) radius = 7;
331	      if (radius > 20) radius = 20;
332	      if (num1 === 1 && radius < 10) radius = 10;
333	    } else if (py > gs.worldSurface + 45) {
334	      radius -= rng.int(0, 3);                                 // Next(4)
335	    }
336	    if (py > gs.rockLevel && num1 > 0) num1 = 0;
337	    num1--;
338	    if (!sideways && py > gs.worldSurface + 20) {
339	      sideways = true;
340	      chasmRunnerSideways(st, rng, gs, Math.floor(px), Math.floor(py), -1, rng.int(20, 39));  // Next(20,40)
341	      chasmRunnerSideways(st, rng, gs, Math.floor(px), Math.floor(py), 1, rng.int(20, 39));
342	    }
343	    // 挖空（cs:76110-76119：num2>5 才挖；CanEvilReplace+非坛/魔矿/猩红矿三门）
344	    if (num1 > 5) {
345	      const x0 = Math.max(0, Math.floor(px - radius * 0.5)), x1 = Math.min(st.w - 1, Math.floor(px + radius * 0.5));
346	      const y0 = Math.max(0, Math.floor(py - radius * 0.5)), y1 = Math.min(st.h, Math.floor(py + radius * 0.5));
347	      for (let x = x0; x < x1; x++) {
348	        for (let y = y0; y < y1; y++) {
349	          const ti = st.idx(x, y);
350	          if (Math.abs(x - px) + Math.abs(y - py) < radius * 0.5 * (1 + rng.int(-10, 10) * 0.015)
351	            && canEvilReplace(st, x, y)
352	            && st.type[ti] !== ORB && st.type[ti] !== DEMONITE && st.type[ti] !== CRIMTANE) {
353	            st.flags[ti] = 0;   // 只清 active（type 保留=幽灵）
354	          }
355	        }
356	      }
357	    }
358	    if (num1 <= 2 && py < gs.worldSurface + 45) num1 = 2;
359	    if (num1 <= 0) {
360	      if (!orbPlaced) {
361	        orbPlaced = true;
362	        addShadowOrb(st, Math.floor(px), Math.floor(py), false);
363	      } else if (!altarPlaced) {
364	        altarPlaced = true;
365	        // cs:76210-76240：纯随机点 → y>worldSurface 才试；IsTileNearby(26,3)+Place3x2，
366	        // 失败重试 ≤10000；y≤worldSurface 直接放弃。★无落点吸附（吸附是猩红散布专属）
367	        let tries = 0, done = false;
368	        while (!done) {
369	          let x = rng.int(Math.floor(px) - 25, Math.floor(px) + 24);   // Next(X-25, X+25)
370	          let y = rng.int(Math.floor(py) - 50, Math.floor(py) - 1);    // Next(Y-50, Y)
371	          x = Math.max(5, Math.min(st.w - 5, x));
372	          y = Math.max(5, Math.min(st.h - 5, y));
373	          if (y > gs.worldSurface) {
374	            if (!isTileNearby(st, x, y, ALTAR, 3)) place3x2(st, x, y, ALTAR, 0);
375	            if (st.type[st.idx(x, y)] === ALTAR) { done = true; continue; }
376	            if (++tries >= 10000) done = true;
377	          } else done = true;
378	        }
379	      }
380	    }
381	    px += vx; py += vy;
382	    vx += rng.int(-10, 10) * 0.01;
383	    vx = Math.max(-0.3, Math.min(0.3, vx));
384	    // 壳1（cs:76282-76296）：CanEvilReplace + 激活/type=25
385	    const x0 = Math.max(1, Math.floor(px - radius * 1.1)), x1 = Math.min(st.w - 1, Math.floor(px + radius * 1.1));
386	    const y0 = Math.max(0, Math.floor(py - radius * 1.1)), y1 = Math.min(st.h, Math.floor(py + radius * 1.1));
387	    for (let x = x0; x < x1; x++) {
388	      for (let y = y0; y < y1; y++) {
389	        const ti = st.idx(x, y);
390	        if (canEvilReplace(st, x, y)
391	          && Math.abs(x - px) + Math.abs(y - py) < radius * 1.1 * (1 + rng.int(-10, 10) * 0.015)) {
392	          if (st.type[ti] !== EBONSTONE && y > j + rng.int(3, 19)) st.flags[ti] = 1;  // Next(3,20)
393	          if (steps <= num3) st.flags[ti] = 1;
394	          if (st.type[ti] !== ORB) st.type[ti] = EBONSTONE;
395	        }
396	      }
397	    }
398	    // 壳2（cs:76309-76322）：type=25 + 激活 + 墙3
399	    for (let x = x0; x < x1; x++) {
400	      for (let y = y0; y < y1; y++) {
401	        const ti = st.idx(x, y);
402	        if (canEvilReplace(st, x, y)
403	          && Math.abs(x - px) + Math.abs(y - py) < radius * 1.1 * (1 + rng.int(-10, 10) * 0.015)) {
404	          if (st.type[ti] !== ORB) st.type[ti] = EBONSTONE;
405	          if (steps <= num3) st.flags[ti] = 1;
406	          if (y > j + rng.int(3, 19)) st.wall[ti] = 3;          // ebonStoneWall
407	        }
408	      }
409	    }
410	  }
411	}

413	/** ChasmRunnerSideways（cs:75323-75523）1:1：水平裂隙。挖空三门同竖直版；
414	 *  壳 = 非31/22/204 才写 type、恒激活、墙2 清零；壳2 = 同门 + 墙3。
415	 *  末端 1/3 TileRunner 魔矿脉（Next(2,6)/Next(3,7), type 22）。 */
416	function chasmRunnerSideways(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState, i: number, j: number, direction: number, steps: number): void {
417	  let num1 = steps + 0.0;
418	  let px = i + 0.0, py = j + 0.0;
419	  let vx = rng.int(10, 20) * 0.1 * direction;                  // Next(10,21)
420	  let vy = rng.int(-10, -1) * 0.01;                            // Next(-10,10)
421	  let radius = rng.int(0, 4) + 7;
422	  while (radius > 0) {
423	    if (num1 > 0) {
424	      radius += rng.int(0, 2) - rng.int(0, 2);
425	      if (radius < 7) radius = 7;
426	      if (radius > 20) radius = 20;
427	      if (num1 === 1 && radius < 10) radius = 10;
428	    } else radius -= rng.int(0, 3);
429	    if (py > gs.rockLevel && num1 > 0) num1 = 0;
430	    num1--;
431	    const x0 = Math.max(0, Math.floor(px - radius * 0.5)), x1 = Math.min(st.w - 1, Math.floor(px + radius * 0.5));
432	    const y0 = Math.max(0, Math.floor(py - radius * 0.5)), y1 = Math.min(st.h, Math.floor(py + radius * 0.5));
433	    for (let x = x0; x < x1; x++) {
434	      for (let y = y0; y < y1; y++) {
435	        const ti = st.idx(x, y);
436	        if (Math.abs(x - px) + Math.abs(y - py) < radius * 0.5 * (1 + rng.int(-10, 10) * 0.015)
437	          && canEvilReplace(st, x, y)
438	          && st.type[ti] !== ORB && st.type[ti] !== DEMONITE && st.type[ti] !== CRIMTANE) {
439	          st.flags[ti] = 0;
440	        }
441	      }
442	    }
443	    px += vx; py += vy;
444	    vy += rng.int(-10, 9) * 0.1;                               // Next(-10,10)
445	    if (py < j - 20) vy += rng.int(0, 19) * 0.01;              // Next(20)
446	    if (py > j + 20) vy -= rng.int(0, 19) * 0.01;
447	    vy = Math.max(-0.5, Math.min(0.5, vy));
448	    vx += rng.int(-10, 10) * 0.01;
449	    if (direction === -1) { if (vx > -0.5) vx = -0.5; if (vx < -2) vx = -2; }
450	    else { if (vx < 0.5) vx = 0.5; if (vx > 2) vx = 2; }
451	    const x2 = Math.max(1, Math.floor(px - radius * 1.1)), x3 = Math.min(st.w - 1, Math.floor(px + radius * 1.1));
452	    const y2 = Math.max(0, Math.floor(py - radius * 1.1)), y3 = Math.min(st.h, Math.floor(py + radius * 1.1));
453	    // 壳1（cs:75477-75490）：墙≠3 门 + 三矿门 → type=25+激活+墙2 清零
454	    for (let x = x2; x < x3; x++) {
455	      for (let y = y2; y < y3; y++) {
456	        const ti = st.idx(x, y);
457	        if (canEvilReplace(st, x, y)
458	          && Math.abs(x - px) + Math.abs(y - py) < radius * 1.1 * (1 + rng.int(-10, 10) * 0.015)
459	          && st.wall[ti] !== 3) {
460	          if (!st.flags[ti] || (st.type[ti] !== ORB && st.type[ti] !== DEMONITE && st.type[ti] !== CRIMTANE)) {
461	            st.type[ti] = EBONSTONE;
462	          }
463	          st.flags[ti] = 1;
464	          if (st.wall[ti] === 2) st.wall[ti] = 0;
465	        }
466	      }
467	    }
468	    // 壳2（cs:75496-75508）：同门 → type=25+激活+墙3
469	    for (let x = x2; x < x3; x++) {
470	      for (let y = y2; y < y3; y++) {
471	        const ti = st.idx(x, y);
472	        if (canEvilReplace(st, x, y)
473	          && Math.abs(x - px) + Math.abs(y - py) < radius * 1.1 * (1 + rng.int(-10, 10) * 0.015)
474	          && st.wall[ti] !== 3) {
475	          if (!st.flags[ti] || (st.type[ti] !== ORB && st.type[ti] !== DEMONITE && st.type[ti] !== CRIMTANE)) {
476	            st.type[ti] = EBONSTONE;
477	          }
478	          st.flags[ti] = 1;
479	          st.wall[ti] = 3;
480	        }
481	      }
482	    }
483	  }
484	  // 末端 1/3 魔矿脉（cs:75512-75520）：列扫到首个活性 → TileRunner(22)
485	  if (rng.int(0, 2) === 0) {
486	    const x = Math.floor(px);
487	    let y = Math.floor(py);
488	    while (y < st.h - 1 && !st.flags[st.idx(x, y)]) y++;
489	    tileRunner(st, rng, gs, x, y, {
490	      strength: rng.int(2, 5), steps: rng.int(3, 6), type: DEMONITE,
491	    });
492	  }
493	  void gs;
494	}

496	/** CrimStart（cs:75543-75852）1:1。SolidTile 扫面（★active 实心）；主通道椭圆走；
497	 *  终点囊群 50 球；血管 5-8 条（方向拒绝采样★原版 quirk：间距比较用主通道末速度
498	 *  val2 而非新采样——cs:75790-75797）；地表囊群 50 球+列填充；CrimEnt 入口。
499	 *  hearts 由调用方收集（原版 CrimPlaceHearts 全组后统一放）。 */
500	function crimStart(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState, i: number, j: number, hearts: Array<[number, number]>): void {
501	  const solidAt = (x: number, y: number) =>
502	    st.inBounds(x, y) && st.flags[st.idx(x, y)] && !!TILE_DEFS[st.type[st.idx(x, y)]]?.solid;  // SolidTile
503	  let py = Math.min(j, gs.worldSurface);
504	  while (py < st.h - 1 && !solidAt(i, py)) py++;
505	  const startY = py;
506	  let px = i + 0.0;
507	  let vx = rng.int(-20, 20) * 0.1;                             // Next(-20,21)
508	  let vy = rng.int(20, 200) * 0.01;                            // Next(20,201)
509	  let crimDir = 1;
510	  if (vx < 0) crimDir = -1;
511	  let radius = rng.int(15, 25);                                // Next(15,26)
512	  let recenter = 0;
513	  for (;;) {
514	    radius += rng.int(-50, 50) * 0.01;
515	    radius = Math.max(15, Math.min(25, radius));
516	    const x0 = Math.floor(px - radius / 2), x1 = Math.floor(px + radius / 2);
517	    const y0 = Math.floor(py - radius / 2), y1 = Math.floor(py + radius / 2);
518	    for (let x = x0; x < x1; x++) {
519	      for (let y = y0; y < y1; y++) {
520	        if (!st.inBounds(x, y)) continue;
521	        if (!canEvilReplace(st, x, y)) continue;
522	        const d = Math.abs(x - px) + Math.abs(y - py);
523	        const ti = st.idx(x, y);
524	        if (y > startY) {
525	          if (d < radius * 0.3) {
526	            st.flags[ti] = 0; st.wall[ti] = 83;                // crimStoneWall
527	          } else if (d < radius * 0.8 && st.wall[ti] !== 83) {
528	            st.flags[ti] = 1; st.type[ti] = CRIMSTONE;
529	            if (d < radius * 0.6) st.wall[ti] = 83;
530	          }
531	        } else if (d < radius * 0.3 && st.flags[ti]) {
532	          st.flags[ti] = 0; st.wall[ti] = 83;
533	        }
534	      }
535	    }
536	    if (px > i + 50) recenter = -100;
537	    if (px < i - 50) recenter = 100;
538	    if (recenter < 0) vx -= rng.int(20, 50) * 0.01;            // Next(20,51)
539	    else if (recenter > 0) vx += rng.int(20, 50) * 0.01;
540	    else vx += rng.int(-50, 50) * 0.01;                        // Next(-50,51)
541	    vy += rng.int(-50, 50) * 0.01;
542	    vy = Math.max(0.25, Math.min(2, vy));
543	    vx = Math.max(-2, Math.min(2, vx));
544	    px += vx; py += vy;
545	    if (py > gs.worldSurface + 100) break;
546	  }
547	  // 终点囊群（cs:75700-75732）：50 个半径 40-54 椭球（x/y 独立 ±20% 缩放）
548	  let endR = rng.int(40, 54);                                  // Next(40,55)
549	  for (let n = 0; n < 50; n++) {
550	    const cx = Math.floor(px) + rng.int(-20, 20);
551	    const cy = Math.floor(py) + rng.int(-20, 20);
552	    for (let x = Math.floor(cx - endR / 2); x < cx + endR / 2; x++) {
553	      for (let y = Math.floor(cy - endR / 2); y < cy + endR / 2; y++) {
554	        if (!st.inBounds(x, y)) continue;
555	        if (!canEvilReplace(st, x, y)) continue;
556	        const ddx = Math.abs(x - cx) * (1 + rng.int(-20, 20) * 0.01);
557	        const ddy = Math.abs(y - cy) * (1 + rng.int(-20, 20) * 0.01);
558	        const d = Math.hypot(ddx, ddy);
559	        const ti = st.idx(x, y);
560	        if (d < endR * 0.25) {
561	          st.flags[ti] = 0; st.wall[ti] = 83;
562	        } else if (d < endR * 0.4 && st.wall[ti] !== 83) {
563	          st.flags[ti] = 1; st.type[ti] = CRIMSTONE;
564	          if (d < endR * 0.35) st.wall[ti] = 83;
565	        }
566	      }
567	    }
568	  }
569	  // 血管（cs:75735-75779）
570	  const veinCount = rng.int(5, 8);                             // Next(5,9)
571	  const usedV: Array<[number, number]> = [];
572	  for (let n = 0; n < veinCount; n++) {
573	    let dvx = 0, dvy = 0, tries = 0;
574	    for (;;) {
575	      dvx = rng.int(-20, 20) * 0.15;                           // 两次 ctor（首对是死代码骰）
576	      dvy = rng.int(0, 20) * 0.15;
577	      while (Math.abs(dvx) + Math.abs(dvy) < 1.5) {
578	        dvx = rng.int(-20, 20) * 0.15;
579	        dvy = rng.int(0, 20) * 0.15;
580	      }
581	      let clash = false;
582	      for (let p = 0; p < n; p++) {
583	        // ★原版 quirk（cs:75790-75797）：比较 val2（主通道末速度）——不是新采样的 dvx/dvy！
584	        if (vx > usedV[p]![0] - 0.75 && vx < usedV[p]![0] + 0.75
585	          && vy > usedV[p]![1] - 0.75 && vy < usedV[p]![1] + 0.75) {
586	          clash = true; tries++;
587	          break;
588	        }
589	      }
590	      if (!clash || tries > 10000) break;
591	    }
592	    usedV.push([dvx, dvy]);
593	    hearts.push(crimVein(st, rng, Math.floor(px), Math.floor(py), dvx, dvy));
594	  }
595	  // 地表囊群（cs:75781-75832）
596	  px = i; py = startY;
597	  endR = rng.int(25, 34);                                      // Next(25,35)
598	  let rise = rng.int(0, 5);                                    // Next(0,6)
599	  let shellMinX = st.w, shellMaxX = 0;
600	  for (let n = 0; n < 50; n++) {
601	    if (rise > 0) {
602	      const step = rng.int(10, 29) * 0.01;                     // Next(10,30)
603	      rise -= step;
604	      py -= step;
605	    }
606	    const cx = Math.floor(px) + rng.int(-2, 2);                // Next(-2,3)
607	    const cy = Math.floor(py) + rng.int(-2, 2);
608	    for (let x = Math.floor(cx - endR / 2); x < cx + endR / 2; x++) {
609	      for (let y = Math.floor(cy - endR / 2); y < cy + endR / 2; y++) {
610	        if (!st.inBounds(x, y)) continue;
611	        if (!canEvilReplace(st, x, y)) continue;
612	        const ddx = Math.abs(x - cx) * (1 + rng.int(-20, 20) * 0.005);
613	        const ddy = Math.abs(y - cy) * (1 + rng.int(-20, 20) * 0.005);
614	        const d = Math.hypot(ddx, ddy);
615	        const ti = st.idx(x, y);
616	        if (d < endR * 0.2 * (rng.int(90, 110) * 0.01)) {     // Next(90,111)
617	          st.flags[ti] = 0; st.wall[ti] = 83;
618	        } else if (d < endR * 0.45) {
619	          if (x < shellMinX) shellMinX = x;
620	          if (x > shellMaxX) shellMaxX = x;
621	          if (st.wall[ti] !== 83) {
622	            st.flags[ti] = 1; st.type[ti] = CRIMSTONE;
623	            if (d < endR * 0.35) st.wall[ti] = 83;
624	          }
625	        }
626	      }
627	    }
628	  }
629	  // 列填充（cs:75834-75848）：壳覆盖范围内每列向下补猩红石（★CanEvilReplace 才消耗）
630	  for (let x = shellMinX; x <= shellMaxX; x++) {
631	    let y = startY;
632	    while (y < st.h - 1 && ((st.flags[st.idx(x, y)] && st.type[st.idx(x, y)] === CRIMSTONE) || st.wall[st.idx(x, y)] === 83)) y++;
633	    let fill = rng.int(15, 19);                                // Next(15,20)
634	    while (y < st.h - 1 && !st.flags[st.idx(x, y)] && fill > 0 && st.wall[st.idx(x, y)] !== 83) {
635	      if (canEvilReplace(st, x, y)) {
636	        fill--;
637	        st.type[st.idx(x, y)] = CRIMSTONE;
638	        st.flags[st.idx(x, y)] = 1;
639	        y++;
640	      }
641	    }
642	  }
643	  // CrimEnt（cs:75989-76030）：★入口锚 = (i, startY)（曾用上升后的 sy）；
644	  //   crimDir 语义 = vx<0 → -1，内部速度 = 2*-crimDir（曾方向取反）
645	  crimEnt(st, rng, i, startY, crimDir);
646	}

648	/** CrimVein（cs:76035-76064）1:1：核心 0.2R 挖空(墙83)/壳 0.5R 猩红石(0.4R 墙)；
649	 *  速度 ±0.75 钳；曼哈顿行程 100-150（vy<0 减 25）。终点 = 心位。 */
650	function crimVein(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, sx: number, sy: number, ivx: number, ivy: number): [number, number] {
651	  let radius = rng.int(15, 25);
652	  let trip = rng.int(100, 149) - (ivy < 0 ? 25 : 0);           // Next(100,150)
653	  let px = sx + 0.0, py = sy + 0.0;
654	  let vx = ivx, vy = ivy;
655	  while (Math.abs(px - sx) + Math.abs(py - sy) <= trip) {
656	    radius += rng.int(-50, 50) * 0.02;
657	    radius = Math.max(15, Math.min(25, radius));
658	    const x0 = Math.floor(px - radius / 2), x1 = Math.floor(px + radius / 2);
659	    const y0 = Math.floor(py - radius / 2), y1 = Math.floor(py + radius / 2);
660	    for (let x = x0; x < x1; x++) {
661	      for (let y = y0; y < y1; y++) {
662	        if (!st.inBounds(x, y)) continue;
663	        if (!canEvilReplace(st, x, y)) continue;
664	        const d = Math.hypot(x - px, y - py);
665	        const ti = st.idx(x, y);
666	        if (d < radius * 0.2) {
667	          st.flags[ti] = 0; st.wall[ti] = 83;
668	        } else if (d < radius * 0.5 && st.wall[ti] !== 83) {
669	          st.flags[ti] = 1; st.type[ti] = CRIMSTONE;
670	          if (d < radius * 0.4) st.wall[ti] = 83;
671	        }
672	      }
673	    }
674	    vx += rng.int(-50, 50) * 0.05;
675	    vy += rng.int(-50, 50) * 0.05;
676	    vx = Math.max(ivx - 0.75, Math.min(ivx + 0.75, vx));
677	    vy = Math.max(ivy - 0.75, Math.min(ivy + 0.75, vy));
678	    px += vx; py += vy;
679	  }
680	  return [Math.floor(px), Math.floor(py)];
681	}
682	
683	/** CrimEnt（cs:75989-76030）1:1：水平入口隧道，只贯穿活性猩红石，连续 20 步无肉即停 */
684	function crimEnt(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, x0: number, y0: number, crimDir: number): void {
685	  let misses = 0;
686	  let radius = rng.int(6, 10);                                 // Next(6,11)
687	  let vx = 2.0, vy = rng.int(-20, -1) * 0.01;                  // Next(-20,0)
688	  vx *= -crimDir;                                              // ★原版：向 crimDir 反向
689	  let px = x0 + 0.0, py = y0 + 0.0;
690	  let alive = true;
691	  while (alive) {
692	    misses++;
693	    if (misses >= 20) alive = false;
694	    radius += rng.int(-10, 10) * 0.02;                        // Next(-10,11)
695	    radius = Math.max(6, Math.min(10, radius));
696	    const bx0 = Math.floor(px - radius / 2), bx1 = Math.floor(px + radius / 2);
697	    const by0 = Math.floor(py - radius / 2), by1 = Math.floor(py + radius / 2);
698	    for (let x = bx0; x < bx1; x++) {
699	      for (let y = by0; y < by1; y++) {
700	        if (!st.inBounds(x, y)) continue;
701	        if (!canEvilReplace(st, x, y)) continue;
702	        const ti = st.idx(x, y);
703	        if (st.flags[ti] && st.type[ti] === CRIMSTONE && Math.hypot(x - px, y - py) < radius * 0.5) {
704	          st.flags[ti] = 0;
705	          alive = true;
706	          misses = 0;
707	        }
708	      }
709	    }
710	    px += vx; py += vy;
711	  }
712	}
713	
714	/** CrimPlaceHearts（cs:75854-75881）1:1：壳(0.4R 猩红石+墙83)→空腔(0.3R)→心。
715	 *  ★原版全组 CrimStart 后一次性调用（曾逐组内联流序错位）。 */
716	function crimPlaceHearts(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, hearts: Array<[number, number]>): void {
717	  for (const [hx, hy] of hearts) {
718	    const r1 = rng.int(16, 20);                                // Next(16,21)
719	    for (let x = hx - Math.floor(r1 / 2); x < hx + r1 / 2; x++) {
720	      for (let y = hy - Math.floor(r1 / 2); y < hy + r1 / 2; y++) {

22	export const grassSpreadState = { n: 0 };
23	let _wsRef: () => number = () => 300;
24	export function setWorldSurfaceRef(fn: () => number): void { _wsRef = fn; }
25	
26	/** SpreadGrass（cs:75210）：dirt==0 时 j≥worldSurface 拒绝（cs:75243 第二门禁——
27	 *  corruption 的 0→23/199 只在地表以上铺）。repeat=true 时 3×3 邻格递归（限 1000） */
28	export function spreadGrassOnce(
29	  st: TileStore, i: number, j: number, dirt: number, grass: number, repeat = false,
30	): void {
31	  if (i < 10 || i >= st.w - 10 || j < 10 || j >= st.h - 10) return;   // InWorld(i,j,10)
32	  const ti = st.idx(i, j);
33	  if (!st.flags[ti] || st.type[ti] !== dirt) return;
34	  // cs:75223-75234（生成期分支）：邪恶草族（199/23）另有专属门——中央 10%（(0.45w,0.55w]）
35	  // 与滩带（beachDistance=380）内禁长；其余草走 (j>=worldSurface && dirt==0) 门。
36	  if (grass === 199 || grass === 23) {
37	    if ((i > st.w * 0.45 && i <= st.w * 0.55) || i < 380 || i >= st.w - 380) return;
38	  } else if (dirt === 0 && j >= _wsRef()) {
39	    return;                                                            // growGrassUnderground=false
40	  }
41	  let enclosed = true;
42	  for (let k = Math.max(0, i - 1); k < Math.min(st.w, i + 2); k++) {
43	    for (let l = Math.max(0, j - 1); l < Math.min(st.h, j + 2); l++) {
44	      const ni = st.idx(k, l);
45	      if (!st.flags[ni] || !TILE_DEFS[st.type[ni]]?.solid) enclosed = false;
46	      if (st.liquidType[ni] === 2 && st.liquid[ni] > 0) { enclosed = true; break; }  // lava
47	    }
48	  }
49	  if (enclosed) return;
50	  // cs:75266：向日葵 27 在头顶 → 邪恶草族（23/661/199/662/109）禁长（生成期无 27，零影响保门）
51	  if ((grass === 23 || grass === 661 || grass === 199 || grass === 662 || grass === 109)
52	    && j - 1 >= 0 && st.type[st.idx(i, j - 1)] === TILE_BY_KEY['v_27_sunflower']) return;
53	  // CanBeClearedDuringGeneration：与 TileRunner NOT_CLEAR 同源（dirt 族可清）
54	  const d = TILE_DEFS[st.type[ti]];
55	  if (d?.vanilla?.sheet != null && NOT_CLEARABLE.has(d.vanilla.sheet)) return;
56	  st.type[ti] = grass;
57	  // 递归洪水（cs:75309-75320）：3×3 邻格同 dirt，grassSpread < 1000
58	  if (!repeat) return;
59	  for (let m = i - 1; m <= i + 1; m++) {
60	    for (let n = j - 1; n <= j + 1; n++) {
61	      if (m < 0 || m >= st.w || n < 0 || n >= st.h) continue;
62	      const ni = st.idx(m, n);
63	      if (st.flags[ni] && st.type[ni] === dirt && grassSpreadState.n < 1000) {
64	        grassSpreadState.n++;
65	        spreadGrassOnce(st, m, n, dirt, grass, true);
66	        grassSpreadState.n--;
67	      }
68	    }
69	  }
70	}

function sonOfLakinater(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState, i: number, j: number, strengthMultiplier = 1): void {
  // cs:80357 头部 Next(3)（liquidType——普通世界恒水，但掷骰必消耗！曾缺失致流偏移）

  let steps = rng.int(30, 60);                         // num2
  if (rng.int(0, 4) === 0) { radius *= 1.3; steps *= 1.3; }
  let px = i + 0.0, py = j + 0.0;
  let wander = rng.next() * (1 / 500);                 // num3
  let vx: number;
  if (rng.int(0, 3) !== 0) {
    vx = rng.int(-15, 15) * 0.01;
  } else {
    vx = rng.int(-50, 50) * 0.01;
    wander = rng.next() * 0.004 + 0.001;
  }
  let vy = rng.int(0, 100) * 0.01;
  const stepsTotal = steps;                            // num4
  while (radius > 3 && steps > 0) {
    radius -= rng.int(0, 10) * 0.1;
    steps--;
    let x0 = Math.floor(px - radius * 4), x1 = Math.floor(px + radius * 4);
    let y0 = Math.floor(py - radius * 3), y1 = Math.floor(py + radius * 2);
    if (x0 < 0) x0 = 0;
    if (x1 > st.w) x1 = st.w;
    if (y0 < 0) y0 = 0;
    if (y1 > st.h) y1 = st.h;
    const r = radius;                                  // num9
    const entranceY = j + 5;                           // num17
    for (let x = x0; x < x1; x++) {
      for (let y = y0; y < y1; y++) {
        if (!st.inBounds(x, y)) continue;
        const ti = st.idx(x, y);
        const t = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, steps / stepsTotal)); // num2/num4（lerp 系数）
        const xc = (Math.abs(x - px) * 0.6) * (1 - t) + (Math.abs(x - px) * 0.3) * t;
        const yc = (Math.abs(y - py) * 1.4) * (1 - t) + (Math.abs(y - py) * 5) * t;
        const dist = Math.hypot(xc, yc);               // num16
        if (dist < r * 0.4) {
          // 湖腔主体：掏空 + 灌水
          if (y >= j) {
            const ti2 = st.idx(x, Math.min(st.h - 1, y));
            if (y <= j + 1 ? willWaterStayPut(st, x, y) : true) {
              st.liquid[ti2] = 255;
              st.liquidType[ti2] = 1;
            }
